headline: The definition, rebuilt · 82:53

items.title: 82:53 · Step two the system concentrates material harm
items.detail: Step two: the system concentrates material harm at the formal intersection of the racialized Out-group O-sub-racialized and the policy set P, ensuring that even facially neutral rules strike the target population disproportionately.

items.title: 83:06 · Step three the system naturalizes the resulting
items.detail: Step three: the system naturalizes the resulting wealth, health, and carceral disparities through ideological narratives that blame the harmed population's culture or biology.

items.title: 83:15 · Step four the system compounds disadvantage intergenerationally
items.detail: Step four: the system compounds disadvantage intergenerationally across housing, schooling, credit, and criminal records so that past extraction becomes the baseline for present extraction.

items.title: 83:25 · Step five the system protects Elite economic
items.detail: Step five: the system protects Elite economic extraction by elevating phase dispersion Phi-sub-load between the white Buffer Class and the racialized Out-group, preventing working-class solidarity.

items.title: 83:35 · This structural definition settles the recurring public
items.detail: This structural definition settles the recurring public debate over scalar prejudice versus vector racism through two linked equations in Chapter 3 and Chapter 25.
